insight: Backed by Andrew Ng's AI Fund; in 2025 launched its own Asyncflow v1.0 text-to-speech model with more than 450 AI voices.
name: Podcastle
tagline: AI-powered studio for recording, editing, and producing audio and video.
description: Podcastle is a browser-based content-creation platform for podcasters and video creators: multi-track remote recording, AI text-to-speech and voice cloning, transcription, and one-click audio and video editing with noise removal and leveling. It bundles studio capture, AI voices, and editing into a single workflow so creators don't need a separate DAW or video editor.

modelSupport.notes: Uses its own Asyncflow TTS model and in-house audio AI.

edge: All-in-one browser studio that combines remote recording, AI voices, transcription, and audio + video editing without a separate DAW.
pros: Recording + AI voices + editing in one app
Voice cloning and transcription built in
cons: Advanced features gated to paid tiers
Less control than a full DAW

references.title: Podcastle launches a text-to-speech model with 450+ AI voices
